swivel.options.title: Swivel
swivel.options.enabled.tooltip: Swing the third-person camera all the way around your character with the mouse. Off gives Minecraft's normal third-person view.
swivel.options.turn_speed.tooltip: How quickly your character turns to face the way it walks. 10 turns instantly.
swivel.options.distance.tooltip: How far behind your character the camera sits, in blocks. Minecraft's default is 4.
swivel.options.smooth_collisions.tooltip: After a wall pushes the camera in, glide back out instead of popping back.
swivel.options.raise_camera.tooltip: Lift the orbit camera above your character's eyes so your head doesn't cover the crosshair. Off keeps Minecraft's camera height.
swivel.options.height.tooltip: How far above your character's eyes the raised camera sits, in blocks.
swivel.options.strafe.tooltip: On: your character keeps facing where the camera looks and sidesteps, like in a shooter. Off: your character turns to face the way it walks.
swivel.options.swivel_running.tooltip: On: once you start moving, the mouse only swings the camera and your character keeps running the same way. Press a different movement key to head where the camera looks. Off: your character always heads where the camera looks.
swivel.options.crosshair.tooltip: Show the crosshair in third person, so you can see what you will mine, hit or use. Off hides it, like Minecraft does.
swivel.options.align_on_exit.tooltip: When you switch back to first person, look where the camera was looking instead of where your character faced.
swivel.options.fade_player.tooltip: Fade your character out when a wall pushes the camera in close, so you can still see in tight spaces. Armor and held items hide once your character is mostly faded.
swivel.options.aim_camera.tooltip: How the camera moves while you draw a bow, crossbow or trident, or hold a loaded crossbow. Shoulder settings move it over your shoulder and closer, Centered only moves it closer, Off leaves it where it is. Your character faces where you aim and sidesteps either way.
swivel.options.spyglass.tooltip: Switch to first person while you look through a spyglass, then back to third person when you stop.
swivel.options.free_look_crosshair.toolt: Hide the crosshair while you free look, since it no longer points at what your character would hit.
swivel.options.keys.tooltip: Set the keys for Free Look (Left Alt), toggling the orbit camera, swinging it back behind you, moving it closer or further away and swapping the aim shoulder. All but Free Look start unbound.
swivel.options.reset.tooltip: Put every Swivel setting back to how it started.
key.swivel.free_look.controller: Hold to look around without turning your character.
key.swivel.toggle.controller: Switch Swivel's orbit camera on or off.
key.swivel.recenter.controller: Swing the orbit camera back behind your character.
key.swivel.zoom_in.controller: Move the third-person camera closer. Hold to keep moving.
key.swivel.zoom_out.controller: Move the third-person camera further away. Hold to keep moving.
key.swivel.swap_shoulder.controller: Switch the aiming camera between your right and left shoulder.
key.swivel.face_camera.controller: Turn your character to face where the camera is looking.
